The theme only appears after you click into the session."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**Root cause:** for "cold" sessions (never opened in this process), `session.list` only reads the pr"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ojection cache's zero-I/O rows (`cachedSnapshot`). - Fail-soft per session: a corrupted log never af"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"fects other sessions and never blocks startup.
